description: Use this when the author asks to show a post card inside the chat or choose publication controls there. After search_posts or search_post_drafts, pass the found post ID as postId. Renders the MCP Apps UI with preview, text editing and scheduling. A screenshot or preview_post URL is not this UI. Opens no public link and never publishes or schedules on its own. If unavailable, refresh the connection's tool metadata; clients without UI retain text/tool workflows.
name: show_post_card
title: Show a Postlyra post in chat
